category_title: Social fourth-grade student with learning disabilities who frequently seeks teacher assistance
minimal_context: Julia is sitting at the computer in her writing class, tasked with independently revising her draft to add vivid descriptions and details.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Julia, please open your draft on the computer. I want you to revise your work independently by adding some actions, feelings, and precise nouns to make the description better.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Raises hand immediately) I don't know what to do. I can't get started on this by myself.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just read what you have so far and try to add some details where you can.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: But I feel really challenged by this writing. I don't know how to spell the new words, and my sentences are all messed up.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep trying. Just do your best to organize your thoughts on the screen.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Complaining) I can't organize it! I struggle with the planning and the grammar, and I need you to come over here and help me fix the sentence structure!
